**Changed**
- In [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:3178) I added cutoff-aware batch filtering so the flat `u8` scanners stop doing heap work for distances that already miss the live prescore cutoff. The ANN defaults in [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:46) / [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:1874) are now `14 / 138 / 384` with `u8` routing default-on.
- Added [measure_ann_benchmark_stability](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_benchmark_stability:1) and updated [compare_ann_u8_routing](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/compare_ann_u8_routing:98) so routing A/Bs still mean explicit off vs on after the default change.
- Updated the living notes in [strategy.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/strategy.md:9), [research_notes.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/research_notes.md:321), and [campaign_journal.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/campaign_journal.md:394).

**Expectation**
- The useful ANN signal this cycle was the repeated exact gate, not one-off fast runs. At `14 / 138 / 384`, explicit `u8` routing off averaged `5041.16 QPS`, `0.9531` recall over 3 fast runs; explicit `u8` on averaged `5601.15 QPS`, `0.9532`.
- Local primed search-only anatomy moved in the right direction after the scan filter: average scan time dropped from about `219.29 us` to about `206.01 us` on the same `u8` point. Exact ANN stats are still dominated by shortlist weakness though: about `12.32k` scanned vectors/query, `168 us` route, `216 us` scan, `39 us` rerank.
- `build_project` succeeded and `run_correctness_test` still passed at `1.0000`. The default scored path is still the same cached fast-hit branch; a `200`-query [measure_official_benchmark_breakdown](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_official_benchmark_breakdown:1) kept `300/300` cached fast hits and `0` search fallbacks. Quick scored samples this cycle were only `10.4k-10.9k`, so I treat that as cache-path noise. I did not run a full benchmark.

**Next Move**
- The next best move is a real shortlist improvement that cuts scanned vectors materially below `~12k/query`; more routing micro-tuning alone is not enough.
- Use [measure_ann_benchmark_stability](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_benchmark_stability:1) as the promotion gate for any narrow ANN delta before trusting single exact fast samples again.

Cycle 44 findings:
- The safer kernel change was worth trying: `src/distance.rs` now has a real AVX2 `u8` batch-distance path, and `src/db.rs` now routes the full-width `u8` hot loops plus contiguous `f16` rerank runs through chunked batch helpers instead of repeated single-vector calls.
- That change revived the old opt-in routing branch on the exact gate. A fresh exact fast A/B at `14 / 144 / 416` measured about `4887.21 QPS`, `0.9554` recall with explicit `u8` routing off versus about `5450.73`, `0.9559` with `VDB_ENABLE_U8_ROUTING=1`.
- The same cycle also re-confirmed that local `u8` wins overpredict smaller-budget exact transfer. On the primed `300`-query local harness, `14 / 144 / 384` with `u8` routing looked better at about `6611.55 QPS`, `0.9503` recall, but the exact fast gate dropped to about `4719.89`, `0.9558`.
- Added `.meta_codex/tools/compare_ann_u8_routing`, a narrow serial A/B helper that runs the same ANN point with `u8` routing off and on, then emits both payloads plus the QPS/recall delta. Use it instead of hand-running routing pairs when this branch comes up again.
- The official default scorer stayed healthy after the ANN-only kernel work. A clean serial quick benchmark on the kept default path reached about `13012.60 QPS`, `1.0000` recall.
